title: An opposite-prompt generator is now live
summary:
A community-shaped day: a new prompt toy shipped, auth got sturdier, and account flows received some necessary reality checks.

A Hacktoberfest contribution added an opposite-prompt generator, then deployment wiring brought it into the running app. Useful for turning a prompt on its head without having to argue with your own imagination.

Authorization and x-api-key handling were repaired, covered with tests, and given better logging. A broken auth.pollinations.ai link was also fixed, so both the sign-in path and the diagnostics around it should behave more like software.

Tier activation gained its first Polar-backed phases, while wallet controls were tidied to avoid showing misleading account timing or actions.
